tips.text: Build Vasto and Dual Skana first, then collect the 2 Argon the day you start the Redeemer; the stack halves at each daily reset.
Rank Vasto and Dual Skana to 30 before building the Redeemer, or build them again later for their Mastery.
Treat Argon as the only chore; everything else is credits and Market blueprints.
